label: Cheesecake
note: Whether it is baked (with eggs) or unbaked (with cream or gelatin) depends on the style. Cream cheese was first made commercially in 1872.

about.text: A dessert of soft fresh cheese, sugar and eggs or cream, on a crumb or pastry base, baked or set cold. Cheese cakes go back to ancient Greece.
